name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: You carry the recovered Defias Docket back to Stormwind as the search for a missing diplomat grows more dangerous.

sections.title: Too Heavy for the Night Watch
sections.body: In Duskwood, Watcher Backus wants no part of the Defias Docket you recovered. Its papers describe plans too intricate to be simple banditry or a diversion. Afraid of royal punishment and wary of his Night Watch superiors, Backus asks you to keep his involvement quiet. The papers point to schemes dangerous enough to end careers or cost lives, so you carry them to Stormwind.

sections.title: A Cheesemonger's True Trade
sections.body: Back in Stormwind's Trade District, Master Cheesemonger Elling Trias drops his shopkeeper's pretense when you return. He studies the docket as a handler in the kingdom's covert intelligence network. The papers describe careful planning by the Defias Brotherhood and name an ominous codename: 'Fist.' The missing diplomat was targeted by a careful, well-connected network with reach deep inside the kingdom.

faq.answer: The Defias Docket is a collection of sensitive papers you recovered in Duskwood, outlining plans by the Defias Brotherhood. Their complexity frightens local watchmen and gives Master Trias new leads in the search for the missing diplomat.

faq.q: Why is Watcher Backus so afraid to keep the docket?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus fears the docket contains information beyond a Duskwood Night Watchman's authority. He worries that if his commanders or Stormwind superiors learn he handled or withheld such intelligence, he could be hanged for treason.

faq.q: Why take the papers to a cheese shop owner in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Elling Trias poses as a cheesemonger, but he is a Stormwind spymaster and a key figure in the kingdom's covert intelligence network. His knowledge and connections help him decipher the Defias plans.

faq.q: Who is 'Fist' mentioned in the docket?
faq.answer: Elling Trias recognizes 'Fist' in the docket as a codename for someone tied to the Defias Brotherhood's coordination of the abduction plot.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: The docket's details let Trias trace the conspirators further. He sends you to question contacts and pursue 'Fist' to learn where the diplomat was taken.

faq.q: What does this have to do with King Varian Wrynn?
faq.answer: The docket does not name King Varian Wrynn. You are searching for an unnamed diplomat who never arrived in Theramore, and Trias's reading of the papers does not reveal the target's identity.

angles.text: Elling Trias shows how roguecraft can trade daggers for information networks. As a rogue, you see how a spymaster deciphers Defias cipher-work in the crown's shadow wars.
As an Alliance member, you see how deeply Stormwind's security has eroded since the Third War, with Defias plans threatening the kingdom from within.
